method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Wall St futures rise as AI stocks gain, oil prices slide
Equities.reason: Broad-market risk-on driven by AI leadership and falling oil (also eases bond pressure). Reuters piece is high-signal for the dominant equity narrative: AI-led outperformance plus commodity/yield relief boosting futures.

Equities.title: US Stock Futures Climb Ahead of Trump-Xi Meeting as Oil Slips
Equities.reason: Market-level optimism: summit risk-reduction plus lower oil supporting cyclicals and growth names. Bloomberg frames macro drivers (geopolitics, oil) that materially move broad equities.

Equities.title: Investors Expect AI Growth to Continue, BofA Survey Shows
Equities.reason: Sentiment/survey confirming persistent investor conviction in AI growth — reinforces tech/AI leadership as a primary equity regime driver.

Equities.title: Stocks advance after Bessent says China talks were successful
Equities.reason: Positive risk impulse from improved US-China communications (Bessent comments) — reduces trade/geopolitical tail risk and supports broad market gains, a meaningful cross-market flow driver.

Equities.title: Dow futures jump 400 points as oil and yields ease to start week
Equities.reason: Concrete market reaction: futures rally tied to easing oil and yields. High direct equity signal that liquidity/yield dynamics are temporarily supportive of risk assets.

Equities.title: German voters turn to left and far-right as 'disaster' for ruling CDU threatens pro-growth reforms
Equities.summary: Another local election drubbing for the ruling CDU has increased political instability and threatens growth prospects, economists said.
Equities.reason: Regional political shock that raises European policy/regulatory risk and could weigh on pro-growth equity themes in Europe — a modest counter-signal to global risk-on.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the September 15-16 FOMC meeting
Rates.summary: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the September 15-16 FOMC meeting
Rates.reason: FOMC projections are the clearest read on the Fed's expected rate path; higher-for-longer projections materially reinforce a bond-selloff narrative (yields up) and are highly market-relevant for rates.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: The FOMC statement communicates the committee's current policy stance and guidance; in the context of recent hikes and hawkish tone this supports elevated yields and a negative bond-price impulse.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Post-FOMC gains face higher hurdle – OCBC
Rates.summary: OCBC’s Christopher Wong notes that the US Dollar Index (DXY) has held a firmer tone after the FOMC’s 25 bp hike and a higher rate path, supported by elevated US Treasury yields.
Rates.reason: Article links USD resilience to elevated US Treasury yields after the FOMC; it's a cross-market confirmation that higher yields remain a key narrative, but FX focus reduces pure rates relevance.

Rates.title: Fed’s Goolsbee: Demand, tariffs, energy, supply shocks all are fuelling inflation
Rates.summary: Chicago Federal Reserve (Fed) Bank President Austan Goolsbee said at an Official Monetary and Financial Institutions Forum event on Monday that various factors including strong demand, tariffs, energy and supply shocks are fuelling United States (US) inflation
Rates.reason: Senior Fed official emphasising persistent/inflationary pressures implies risk of faster or larger hikes → upward pressure on yields; high relevance as it shapes Fed expectations.

Rates.title: Fed's Kashkari says inflation is still too high in 'all aspects' of US economy, in Fox News interview
Rates.reason: Another Fed policymaker stressing persistent inflation reinforces a hawkish policy backdrop—negative for bonds (yields higher) and relevant to market pricing of rate risk.

Rates.title: Short-Term Treasuries Emerge as Popular Bet on Fed Inflation Win
Rates.reason: Flows into short-term Treasuries signal a market bet that inflation fears could recede and the Fed will 'win'—this is a constructive (yield-down) pocket within a broader hawkish regime and acts as a meaningful counter-signal.

Rates.title: Treasury yields ease as global borrowing costs tumble
Rates.summary: Treasury yields were lower on Monday following last week's interest rate bonanza.
Rates.reason: Reported near-term decline in Treasury yields is directly positive for bond prices; this immediate market move offsets some of the higher-for-longer narrative and has clear rates-market impact.

Rates.title: See the 10-Year Treasury Yield’s Wild Ride on the Road to 5%
Rates.reason: Contextual piece charting the recent rise toward 5% on the 10-year underlines the prevailing higher-yield regime; useful market vignette reinforcing negative pressure on bond prices.

Rates.title: Markets Can Handle a Hawkish Fed, Not Uncertainty
Rates.reason: Analysis highlights that policy uncertainty—not the hawkish tilt per se—is the market stabiliser/risk; overall this reinforces a cautious/higher-yield environment while flagging volatility risk for rates.

Rates.title: Bank rate maintained at 3.75% - September 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
Rates.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.
Rates.reason: BoE holding the Bank Rate is a direct rates decision; modestly supportive of a higher-for-longer narrative in the UK (no easing) but less globally pivotal than Fed signals, so treated as near-neutral-to-slightly-negative for gilts.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ hike underwhelms as yields drive JPY against US Dollar – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC’s Christopher Wong notes that the Japanese Yen (JPY) weakened after the BoJ’s 25 bp hike to 1.25% as limited guidance on further normalisation disappointed hawkish expectations.
FX.reason: BoJ hike seen as dovish relative to expectations, prompting JPY weakness vs USD — reinforces USD strength narrative and moves a key G10 FX pair. High relevance given BoJ policy shock and USD/JPY market impact.

FX.title: US Dollar: Oil-driven support as Fed seen hiking – ING
FX.summary: ING strategist Francesco Pesole notes the Dollar remains supported as ING now expects the Fed to deliver one final rate hike in December. Despite near-term upside risks for the Dollar, ING keeps a gradually negative longer-term view and anticipates lower energ
FX.reason: Explicit Fed hike expectation = direct USD support. This is a primary driver for USD strength vs major currencies, so high relevance to the FX/USD narrative.

FX.title: Experts agree: Further US Dollar’s upside hinges on upcoming data and not hawkish Fed prospects
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) trades slightly higher on Monday as traders remain confident that the Federal Reserve (Fed) will hike interest rates again this year. At press time, the US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback’s value against six major currencies,
FX.reason: Reinforces conditional USD upside tied to upcoming US data; relevant to DXY and near-term USD moves but more of a reiteration than a new shock — moderate relevance.

FX.title: Australian Dollar edges higher on renewed RBA hike bets ahead of Bullock, jobs data
FX.summary: AUD/USD edges higher on Monday, trading around 0.7130 at the time of writing, up 0.06% on the day. The Australian Dollar (AUD) benefits mainly from strengthening expectations that the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) could raise interest rates again at its mone
FX.reason: RBA hike bets supporting AUD vs USD — represents a clear non-USD strength move in a major commodity currency, relevant to USD-basket dynamics and carry trade flows.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ rate check limits yen downside – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes that the Japanese Yen initially weakened sharply after the latest BoJ policy update, with USD/JPY briefly above 158.00 before retreating towards 157.00.
FX.reason: Notes that the initial JPY weakness was partly checked — a small counter to broad USD-strength flow. Useful nuance but lower relevance than the primary BoJ-driven weakness narrative.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar wavers near two-month lows despite a brighter market mood
FX.summary: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) languishes just above two-and-a-half-month lows against the US Dollar (USD), despite a somewhat brighter market mood, as a sustained reversal in Oil prices has eased risk aversion on Monday.
FX.reason: NZD weakness vs USD highlights ongoing USD strength / NZD-specific weakness; relevant for EM/commodity-linked FX flows but relatively low market-moving impact.

FX.title: Indian Rupeee gains due to further correction in oil prices
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) starts the week on a positive note against the US Dollar (USD). The USD/INR pair drops to near 95.75 as the Indian currency gains due to continuous support from correcting oil prices.
FX.reason: Oil-driven INR appreciation is a typical commodity-to-currency transmission and indicates selective EM currency strength vs USD — modest relevance for broader USD/EM flow picture.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Volatility focus after BoJ – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Michael Wan highlights that USD/JPY remains in focus after the Bank of Japan raised rates by 25bps to 1.25%, with markets interpreting the meeting as relatively dovish.
FX.reason: Reinforces dominant USD/JPY volatility and USD-strength narrative following a BoJ move perceived as dovish — material for G10 FX positioning and risk flows.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar remains under pressure as hawkish Fed contrasts with steady BoC
FX.summary: USD/CAD holds firm near the 1.4000 psychological mark on Monday as the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) hawkish outlook and widening US-Canada interest-rate differentials keep the Canadian Dollar (CAD) on the back foot.
FX.reason: Clear USD-strength theme driven by Fed-BoC divergence impacting a commodity-linked major currency (CAD). High relevance for USD-basket and cross-market flows (oil-sensitive FX).

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecasts: Bears remain in control with 1.1450 support eyed
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) is consolidating last week’s decline against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday, with price action capped below 1.1500 and the seven-week low in the mid 1.1400s still on the bears’ radar.
FX.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece showing EUR weakness vs USD. Classified as technical analysis so relevance capped; still consistent with USD-strength theme.

FX.title: Mexican Peso: Sideways range against US Dollar intact – Rabobank
FX.summary: Rabobank's Christian Lawrence and Molly Schwartz expect USD/MXN to trade broadly between 17 and 18 over the next 12 months. They see room for both Fed and Banxico rate expectations to be repriced, with the timing of those adjustments likely to drive near-term
FX.reason: Range-bound USD/MXN call is FX-native but low signal for near-term directional shifts; included for EM/LatAm FX context with low relevance.

FX.title: Swiss Franc recovery halts with SNB monetary policy coming into focus
FX.summary: The Swiss Franc (CHF) nurses minor losses against the US Dollar (USD) to pare some of the previous two trading days’ recovery.
FX.reason: SNB policy focus and CHF moves vs USD are relevant to safe-haven and cross-G10 dynamics, but this item describes minor moves so relevance is moderate.

FX.title: Euro: Downside risks persist despite ECB hike call – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Francesco Pesole explains that despite political noise in Germany and an additional ECB hike now expected in December, ING keeps its EUR/USD profile unchanged with a 1.160 year-end target.
FX.reason: Affirms EUR downside vs USD despite ECB considerations — relevant to EUR/USD and euro-area rate expectations, supporting the broader USD-strength narrative.

FX.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Sees fresh downside leg below 0.5700
FX.summary: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) trades marginally higher against the US Dollar (USD) at around 0.5727 during the European trading session on Monday even as the US Dollar Index (DXY) is positive. At press time, the USD Index is up 0.1% higher to near 100.31.
FX.reason: Technical forecast noting potential NZD downside vs a positive DXY. Classified as price-forecast content so relevance capped, but supports USD-positive bias.

FX.title: Emerging-Market Stocks, Currencies Gain After US-China Talks
FX.reason: EM currencies gaining after US-China talks signals a risk-on / USD-weakness impulse for EMFX flows. Important cross-border political development with direct currency transmission; medium-high relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold: Range-bound outlook with Fed headwinds – ING
Commodities.summary: ING’s commodities team reports Gold eased as markets digest the Federal Reserve’s first rate hike since 2023 and guidance for prolonged restrictive policy. They stress that higher rates remain a headwind, but ETF holdings at six‑month highs and ongoing central
Commodities.reason: Fed rate-hike guidance is a clear headwind for gold (higher rates -> higher opportunity cost), though ETF and central-bank demand provide offsetting support; strong macro narrative for precious metals.

Commodities.title: Gold: CTA whipsaws but support holds – TD Securities
Commodities.summary: TD Securities’ commodity strategists report that CTAs (Commodity Trading Advisors) have reversed recent Gold buying, yet emphasize that discretionary investors continue to support the metal.
Commodities.reason: Reinforces dominant cautious/soft gold tone from systematic selling, but discretionary and strategic support caps downside — moderates overall negative bias.

Commodities.title: Silver price edges up as lower Oil, guarded Fed stance temper upside
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) starts the week on a positive note, gaining 0.37% on Monday to trade around $66.50 at the time of writing. The precious metal manages to advance despite a stable US Dollar (USD), with the US Dollar Index (DXY) trading virtually unchanged aroun
Commodities.reason: Small near-term uptick; silver benefits from lower oil and still-hovering industrial/precious demand, but Fed rate expectations cap upside — modest bullish signal with limited relevance.

Commodities.title: Corpus Christi LNG expansion makes facility the second-largest in the United States
Commodities.summary: On August 28, 2026, Cheniere Energy, Inc., completed its Corpus Christi Liquefaction Stage 3 Project (CCL Stage 3) in Texas, taking custody and control of the seventh and last liquefied natural gas (LNG) train in the project.
Commodities.reason: Additional LNG liquefaction capacity increases US export capability which can tighten domestic natural gas balances and support prices — a structurally positive supply-demand implication for natural gas.

Commodities.title: China Buys More US Soybeans Just Days Before Trump-Xi Summit
Commodities.reason: Fresh Chinese buying is a clear demand shock for US soybeans, supportive for soybean prices and global oilseed complex; geopolitically-timed purchases increase market significance.

Commodities.title: Wheat Jumps After Positive Signals From Initial US-China Talks
Commodities.reason: Positive diplomatic signals translate into demand optimism for US agricultural exports; immediate price jump indicates meaningful demand-side support for wheat.

Commodities.title: Satellite Snapshot Points to Increase in Saudis’ Gulf Oil Flows
Commodities.reason: Signals of increased Saudi crude flows imply a near-term supply boost to global oil markets, weighing on Brent/WTI — a material negative for oil prices and the dominant energy narrative today.

Commodities.title: U.S. crude oil falls back below $100 per barrel after Trump says he's open to talking to Iran
Commodities.summary: Oil fell Monday, as traders keep watch for a recovery in shipments from Saudi Arabia, even as Mideast tensions continue to escalate.
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical détente comments and expectations of Saudi shipment recovery are depressing crude prices — clear short-term bearish signal for oil.

Commodities.title: Brent: Diesel signals higher prices – Societe Generale
Commodities.summary: Societe Generale analysts Michael Haigh and Jeremy Sellem highlight a sharp divergence between physical Brent and futures, with Dated Brent trading at a substantial premium. They note that Diesel strength implies Brent should be above $150/bbl to restore histo
Commodities.reason: Physical diesel strength and dated-Brent premium point to structural tightness in refined products and can be bullish for crude; important counter-signal to broader easing, but lower relevance vs prevailing flow.

Commodities.title: What goes into diesel prices?
Commodities.summary: The price of distillate fuel oil, often sold as diesel, is driven by the price of crude oil, retail margins, distribution costs, taxes, and crack spreads, the indicator we use for refining margins. Tight global supplies of distillate fuel oil and elevated crud
Commodities.reason: EIA notes tight distillate supplies and strong crack spreads — supportive for refined-product prices and a secondary bullish influence on crude fundamentals.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin hits highest level since January at $85,000, as the market debates whether the 'crypto winter' is over
Crypto.summary: Bitcoin rose above $85,000 on Monday extending a rally over the past few days.
Crypto.reason: Large, broad BTC price breakout reported by mainstream media — reinforces a dominant bull-run narrative and risk-on flows into crypto; high market relevance.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin hits $85,000 as short squeeze forces out $648 million of bearish bets
Crypto.reason: Explains microstructure driver (large short liquidations) behind the rally — mechanically bullish for price and derivatives positioning; materially market-moving.

Crypto.title: Strategy returns to bitcoin buys, adding $75 million of BTC last week
Crypto.reason: Institutional accumulation (large fund buying) supports sustained demand thesis and complements the price rally narrative — meaningful for flows and balance of supply/demand.

Crypto.title: Perp futures linked to 'bitcoin VIX' debut on Hyperliquid
Crypto.reason: New derivatives linked to BTC volatility broaden risk-management tools and market depth — incremental positive for institutional participation and liquidity.

Crypto.title: CFTC sends crypto rules to White House to review as Congress stalls on Clarity Act
Crypto.reason: Regulatory progress at the agency level advances formal rulemaking/clarity even as Congress lags — net positive for institutional adoption and legal certainty in the medium term.

Crypto.title: Crypto tech provider Haruko hit by cyberattack affecting 15 clients, some funds lost
Crypto.reason: Operational security breach with client fund losses undermines custody/infrastructure trust — materially negative for sentiment, counterparty risk and short-term flows.

Crypto.title: Kalshi faces ‘fake crypto volume’ allegations as critic flags identical $5,500 trades
Crypto.reason: Allegations of fabricated volume on a trading venue raise market integrity concerns — negative for confidence in reported liquidity and price action, but more localized.

Crypto.title: Why Is Bitcoin Up Today? It Closed Above Its 50-Week Average for the First Time in 45 Weeks.
Crypto.reason: Technical breakout above a multi-month moving average supports bullish sentiment but is primarily a technical/short-term signal — lower relevance than flow/regulatory drivers.

Crypto.title: Robinhood Chain fees collapse 97% even as transactions stay near record highs
Crypto.reason: Much lower on-chain fees with high throughput suggests improving user economics and network scaling — modestly positive for on-chain activity and retail engagement.
